notes: Демо-календарь группы 15.14Д-ГГ04/266 встроен непосредственно в app.js и загружается без сетевого обращения к Sync Gateway. Доступен период 9–23 ноября 2026 года; для прочих групп прежний live provider сохранён. Дополнительно подключён календарный снимок Vuzio для группы 15.14Д-ММ05/26б: 48 занятий за 16–30 ноября 2026 года. Реестр содержит две подтверждённые группы; остальные группы требуют своих уникальных ICS или проверки live-источника. Tavrimo 12.2.0 updates the existing PWA to a single Spotify-inspired dark design system; existing local data schema v17, timetable snapshots, sync paths, task behavior and backup formats are unchanged. Tavrimo 12.3.0 adds separate external iCalendar sources: local .ics file imports plus read-only Google Calendar, Outlook and iCloud HTTPS feeds through a restricted Sync Gateway endpoint. External calendars coexist with the REA timetable, are considered in availability/conflict calculations, and retain the last successful snapshot offline. Personalized greeting uses the device local time and an optional display name saved locally in browser storage. Feed links are private read-only capabilities and are included in JSON backup; treat backups as sensitive. This is ICS subscription/import, not OAuth account linking or two-way event editing.
summary: Multi-calendar update for Tavrimo: external iCalendar file imports and read-only Google Calendar, Outlook and iCloud feeds alongside the REA timetable, plus a personalized local-time greeting. Existing local schema v17, task behavior, REA calendar and backup compatibility are retained.
design: Spotify-inspired Dark UI based on the supplied DESIGN.md, using original Tavrimo coffee-cup branding and system/Inter typography; no Spotify logo or proprietary font.
